tests.case: preserves all six reading-surface prose measures and wrapping Steam consent

ProseMeasureTests.Desktop_prose_keeps_it.reason: Native desktop measures both source widths, 700 and 1400, at height 900 across Platforms, Spending, Application, Library, Appearance/Theme Studio and Merges, preserving all six source reading surfaces.
